 Published 13 November 2026, 13:27 WAT New Informate 2 minutes wey don pass Read am in 2 mins First Half
 20' Nigeria player fall for ground afta tackle from Tanzania player but e don stand up and game don continue.
 15' Nigeria still dey control di ball but second goal neva come while Tanzania dey hustle to break Nigeria defence.
 10' Nigeria dey dominate do game so far as Akor no dey give di Taifa starts space to play di game.
 7' Match don resume wit freeklick for Nigeria, dem play am toward goall but e go wide.
 5' Tanzania player dey for ground dey collect medical attention afta e Nigerian opponent tackle am.
 Nigeria 1-0 Tanzania 
 2' GOALLLLLLLL Alhassan Yusuf score for Nigeria. Alhassan Yusuf score afta Ademola Lookman pass ball give am.

 Nigeria go play against Tanzania for Godswill Akpabio International Stadium, Uyo, on Friday for di third round of di 2027 Africa Cup of Nations (Afcon) qualifiers.
 Nigeria lose dia last match in a surprising way, and dem go now hope to return to winning ways.
 Tanzania never win any of dia previous matches, as dem manage to get only one point from dia two games.
 Nigeria don win four, draw four and lose two of dia last 10 matches. Tanzania get one win, three draws and six defeats within di same period.
 Dis difference make Nigeria look more likely to win di match, although Tanzania three draws show why one-goal winning margin fit be a reasonable expectation.
